query: UPDATE oauth_tokens AS grant_tokens INNER JOIN oauth_tokens AS spent_tokens ON spent_tokens.user_token = grant_tokens.user_token AND spent_tokens.client_token = grant_tokens.client_token INNER JOIN oauth_spent_refresh_hashes ON oauth_spent_refresh_hashes.oauth_token_id = spent_tokens.id SET grant_tokens.maybe_revoked_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE oauth_spent_refresh_hashes.refresh_hash = ? AND spent_tokens.client_token = ? AND grant_tokens.maybe_revoked_at IS NULL
